title: memory.recall request
description: plugin → companion, the payload of a `call` with op `memory.recall`. Every level the conversation sits under — the organization, its folders, the conversation — searched for the query, the closest level winning a near-duplicate. `deadlineMs` is the plugin's whole budget: the companion and the platform each answer inside it, so a prefetch bound is never the one that fires. The companion refuses a request it did not ring (`not_permitted`).
